title: Checks for the presence of unused arguments in function definitions.
summary: An argument that is defined but not used is likely a mistake, and should be removed to avoid confusion. Ruff takes this rule from flake8-unused-arguments and made it stable in v0.0.168.

title: Check argument types.
summary: Mypy checks that argument types in a call match the declared argument types in the signature of the called function (if one exists). mypy enables this error code by default.
